lcc_original: 你要給樓船造透光處，向上作到高一肘，也要把樓船的門設在旁邊，把船作成了一【5】二三三層。
notes: WAH09001 (ל 'for') detached from WH08392 and attached to 給 instead, because LCC renders the dative preposition explicitly as 給 before 樓船, whereas UNV fused both tags onto 方舟

UNV's implicit {<WAH0413>} (אֶל 'to/toward') is rendered explicitly as 到 in LCC's 作到; UNV's implicit {<WH03615>}{<WTH8762>} (תְּכַלֶּנָּה 'finish/complete it') is rendered explicitly as 作 — both implicit markers become explicit words in LCC, so braces are dropped

LCC uses 一/二/三 (ordinal sequence) for the three decks rather than UNV's directional 下/中/上 (lower/middle/upper); mapped in Hebrew-order: 一→H8482 (תַּחְתִּי lower), 二→H8145 (שֵׁנִי second/middle), 三→H7992 (שְׁלִישִׁי third/upper)
向上 = מִלְמַעְלָה ('from above') tagged with WAH04480+WAH09001+WH04605, corresponding to UNV's 上邊 with the same three tags
